run_clang_tidy_on_files: run clang-tidy against one or more C++ source files using the script
run_clang_tidy_with_fix: run clang-tidy with the --fix flag to automatically apply suggested fixes to C++ files
run_clang_tidy_parallel: run clang-tidy on multiple files in parallel by specifying the number of jobs with -j
configure_clang_tidy_binary: configure the clang-tidy binary path by setting the CLANG_TIDY environment variable
parse_clang_complete_includes: parse the .clang_complete file to extract -I include paths for clang-tidy extra arguments
